ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
17. Four charges $Q_1$, $Q_2$, $Q_3$ and $Q_4$ of same magnitude are fixed along the $x$ axis at $x = -2a$, $-a$, $+a$ and $+2a$, respectively. A positive charge $q$ is placed on the positive $y$ axis at a distance $b > 0$. Four options of the signs of these charges are given in List I. The direction of the forces on the charge $q$ is given in List II. Match List I with List II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists.

List I
P. $Q_1$, $Q_2$, $Q_3$, $Q_4$ all positive
Q. $Q_1$, $Q_2$ positive; $Q_3$, $Q_4$ negative
R. $Q_1$, $Q_4$ positive; $Q_2$, $Q_3$ negative
S. $Q_1$, $Q_3$ positive; $Q_2$, $Q_4$ negative

List II
1. $+x$
2. $-x$
3. $+y$
4. $-y$

The resultant forces of both groups of symmetric charges are along +x, so the direction of the total resultant force is +x.

method.method_draft: Use symmetry and force directions in pairs. From the diagram, pair Q2 at x = -a with Q3 at x = +a, and pair Q1 at x = -2a with Q4 at x = +2a; q is on the y-axis above the origin. From the text, Q1 and Q2 are positive, Q3 and Q4 are negative, all with equal magnitude, and q is positive. For each symmetric pair, the left positive charge repels q along an up-right direction, while the right negative charge attracts q along a down-right direction. Because the two charges in each pair are equidistant from q and equal in magnitude, their vertical components cancel while their horizontal components both point to +x. Adding both pairs gives a net force along +x.

method.method_draft: Compute the sign of the vector sum using Coulomb-law components. From the coordinates, take the force contribution on q from a charge Q_i at x_i as proportional to Q_i(-x_i, b)/(x_i^2 + b^2)^{3/2}, since q is positive and located at (0,b). Assign Q1 = Q2 = +Q at x = -2a, -a and Q3 = Q4 = -Q at x = +a, +2a. For the symmetric pair x = -a with +Q and x = +a with -Q, the y-components are +kQqb/R^3 and -kQqb/R^3, so they cancel; the x-components are both positive. The same cancellation/addition occurs for the pair x = -2a and x = +2a. Therefore the total y-component is zero and the total x-component is positive, so the force is in the +x direction.
